sections.text: Careers at FLORENCESS
1) Who We Are

At FLORENCESS (operated by Tianjin Xigucheng Educational Technology Co., Ltd.), we’re more than just an e-commerce store for fashion, bags, and shoes. We are a creative, forward-thinking team based in London, passionate about design, sustainability, and delivering exceptional customer experiences.
2) Our Culture
• Creativity & Innovation — We encourage fresh ideas, bold thinking, and continuous improvement.
• Sustainability — We strive to reduce environmental impact through responsible sourcing and mindful production.
• Collaboration — We believe teamwork drives success, and we celebrate diversity and inclusion.
• Customer-First Mindset — Every role contributes to building lasting relationships with our customers.
3) Opportunities
We’re growing and regularly seek talented people in areas such as:
• Fashion Design & Product Development
• E-commerce Operations & Logistics
• Digital Marketing & Social Media
• Customer Support & Community Engagement
• Technology & Web Development
Even if you don’t see a role listed, we welcome proactive applications from individuals who share our vision.
4) How to Apply
If you’re excited about joining us:
1. Send your CV and cover letter to .
2. Use the subject line: Application – [Position Title].
3. Share why you want to be part of FLORENCESS and how your skills can make an impact.
Our team reviews every application carefully. If shortlisted, we’ll reach out for the next steps.
5) Contact for Careers
• Company: Tianjin Xigucheng Educational Technology Co., Ltd.
• Registered Address: Room C1090, 3A01, 3rd Floor, No. 6 Wuxi Road, Zhongluotan Town, Baiyun District, Guangzhou, Guangdong, China

1) Join the FLORENCESS Affiliate Program

At FLORENCESS (operated by Tianjin Xigucheng Educational Technology Co., Ltd.), we believe in the power of collaboration. Our Affiliate Program is designed to reward creators, influencers, bloggers, and partners who share our vision of stylish, sustainable fashion.
2) Why Partner With Us?
• Attractive Commissions – Earn a percentage of every sale you refer through your unique affiliate link.
• High-Quality Products – Clothing, bags, and shoes crafted with attention to design, materials, and sustainability.
• Marketing Support – Access to banners, product images, and exclusive promotions to maximize your reach.
• Trusted Brand – Operated in London with a growing customer base worldwide.
3) How It Works
1. Apply Online – Submit your application with basic details about your platform and audience.
2. Get Approved – Once approved, you’ll receive a unique affiliate link and access to our partner dashboard.
3. Promote – Share FLORENCESS products via your blog, social media, or email campaigns.
4. Earn – Receive commissions for each sale generated through your referral link.
4) Commission & Payouts
• Standard commission starts at 10% per sale.
• Top performers may receive higher rates or bonus incentives.
• Payouts are processed monthly via PayPal (other methods may be available upon request).
5) Who Can Join?
• Fashion bloggers and lifestyle influencers
• Social media creators (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, etc.)
• Website owners and content publishers
• Email marketers with relevant audiences
• Anyone passionate about fashion and aligned with FLORENCESS’s values
6) How to Apply
Interested? Apply by contacting our affiliate team:
• Email: (Subject: Affiliate Program Application)
• Please include details of your platforms, audience size, and how you plan to promote FLORENCESS.

Customer Rewards Program

At FLORENCESS, we value our customers and believe that every purchase should bring you closer to something more. That’s why we created the Customer Rewards Program—a simple, transparent way to thank you for shopping with us.
1) How It Works
• Earn Points on Every Purchase
For every $1 spent, you earn 1 Reward Point (excluding shipping and taxes).
• Welcome Bonus
New customers receive a 100-point sign-up bonus after creating an account.
• Extra Points
Earn additional points during seasonal promotions, product launches, or special events.
2) Redeeming Points
• 1 Point = $0.01 towards future purchases.
• You can redeem points at checkout once you’ve accumulated a minimum of 500 points ($5 value).
• Points can be applied to product totals but not to shipping fees, taxes, or gift cards.
3) Member Tiers
The more you shop, the more benefits you unlock:
• Silver (0–999 points): Standard earning & redemption.
• Gold (1,000–4,999 points): +10% faster point accumulation.
• Platinum (5,000+ points): +20% faster point accumulation + exclusive previews and early access to sales.
4) Validity & Expiry
• Points remain valid for 12 months from the date they are earned.
• Expired points are automatically deducted from your account balance.
5) Returns & Adjustments
• If you return or cancel an order, points earned from that purchase will be deducted.
• If you paid partly with points, refunded points will be credited back to your account.
6) Checking Your Balance
• Log into your FLORENCESS account → My Rewards to view your points balance, tier status, and redemption options.
• Points earned from new purchases may take up to 48 hours after order confirmation to appear.
7) Contact
Questions about your rewards? We’re here to help:

1) Accepted Payment Methods
You can pay at checkout with:
• PayPal.
• Credit or debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, and other major cards).
• Apple Pay, where supported by your device and browser.
• Google Pay, where supported by your device and browser.
The methods shown on the checkout page are the ones available for your order.
2) Currency & Pricing
• Orders are processed in the currency shown at checkout.
3) Payment Timing
• Your selected payment method is charged when your order is confirmed.
4) Security & Privacy
• Checkout is protected by HTTPS/SSL end-to-end.
5) Checkout Details
• Please use the details requested at checkout.
6) Refunds & Cancellations
• Refunds are returned to the original payment method only.
• Refund timing depends on the original payment provider and your bank.
(For full return eligibility and timelines, please see our Returns & Refunds Policy.)
7) Troubleshooting a Payment
If you can’t complete checkout, try clearing your browser cache, switching device or browser, or contacting us.
8) Contact
If you need help placing an order or have a payment question, we’re here to help:

1) Eligibility for Returns & Exchanges
• You may request a return or exchange within 14 days after the order is delivered.
• Items must be unused, unworn, unwashed, and returned in their original packaging, with all original tags and labels intact.
• Footwear and bags must be tried on or inspected only on clean surfaces and must be returned without scuffs, marks, stains, or other signs of use.
• Items marked as Final Sale, Clearance, Personalized, or Custom-Made cannot be returned or exchanged unless they arrive damaged, defective, incorrect, or materially different from their description.
2) How to Start a Return or Exchange
1. Contact us at service@entntnt.com with your order number, the item you wish to return or exchange, and the reason for your request.
2. Wait for our confirmation, return instructions, designated return address, and Return Authorization number before sending the merchandise back.
3. Pack the merchandise securely, include proof of purchase, and clearly write the Return Authorization number on or inside the parcel.
4. Ship the merchandise to the return address provided in our confirmation email using a trackable shipping service.
Returns sent without prior authorization, sent to an unauthorized address, or returned without sufficient identifying information may be delayed or refused.
3) Condition & Inspection
• All returned merchandise will be inspected after delivery to our designated return address.
• Merchandise that is worn, washed, altered, damaged after delivery, missing tags, or otherwise not in its original condition may be rejected or may not qualify for a full refund.
• Approved merchandise refunds will be issued only to the original payment method used for the order.
• Merchandise refunds will not be issued before the returned item is received and inspected, unless otherwise required by the applicable payment provider or law.
4) Refunds
• Approved refunds will generally be processed within 5–10 business days after the returned merchandise is received and approved.
• Additional processing time may be required by the customer’s bank, PayPal, card issuer, or other original payment provider.
• Original outbound shipping charges are non-refundable when the return is based on personal preference, sizing, change of mind, or another reason not caused by us.

• If the return is caused by an incorrect, damaged, defective, or materially misdescribed item, any approved product refund will be issued to the original payment method. Applicable original shipping charges will also be refunded when appropriate.
5) Exchanges
• Exchanges are subject to product and size availability.
• If the requested replacement is unavailable, we may offer an alternative item or issue an approved refund to the original payment method.
• For exchanges based on personal preference, sizing, or change of mind, the customer is responsible for return shipping costs.

• If the exchange is required because we sent an incorrect, damaged, defective, or materially misdescribed item, we will reimburse the reasonable cost of standard trackable return shipping as described below.
6) Damaged, Defective, Incorrect, or Misdescribed Items
• If you receive an item that is damaged, defective, incorrect, or materially different from its description, please contact us within 14 days after delivery.
• Please provide your order number and clear photographs or other information showing the reported issue so that we can review the request.
• After receiving our return authorization and designated return address, the customer may initially pay the cost of standard trackable return shipping.
• The customer must retain and provide the return tracking number and a valid shipping receipt showing the actual amount paid.
• After the returned merchandise is delivered to our designated return address and inspected, we will reimburse the actual and reasonable cost of standard trackable return shipping.
• Return-shipping reimbursement may be issued separately through PayPal, bank transfer, or another payment method agreed upon with the customer.
• Expedited shipping, overnight shipping, optional insurance, packaging services, and other additional charges will not be reimbursed unless approved by us in writing before the return is shipped.
• After the return is received and approved, we will send a replacement or issue the applicable merchandise refund to the original payment method.
7) Non-Returnable Items
The following items generally cannot be returned or exchanged:
• Personalized or customized merchandise;
• Clearance or Final Sale merchandise;
• Merchandise that has been worn, washed, altered, stained, damaged after delivery, or returned without its original tags;
• Merchandise returned outside the applicable return period;
• Merchandise sent without authorization or to an address not designated by us.

These restrictions do not apply when an item arrives damaged, defective, incorrect, or materially different from its description, subject to our review of the customer’s request and supporting information.
1) How to Track Your Order
• Once your order is shipped, you will receive a shipping confirmation email containing your tracking number and a direct link to the courier’s website.
• You can also track your order by logging into your FLORENCESS account → My Orders.
• If you checked out as a guest, you can still track your order via the link in your confirmation email.
2) Tracking Updates
• Please allow 24–48 hours after shipment for tracking information to update on the courier’s website.
• During peak seasons or public holidays, updates may take longer.
3) Shipping Carriers
We work with trusted carriers (varies by destination), including but not limited to:
• DHL Express
• FedEx
• UPS
• Royal Mail / local postal partners
4) Delivery Timeline
• Delivery times depend on your location and the shipping method selected at checkout.
• Estimated delivery ranges are shown on your checkout page before you confirm payment.
• Please note that customs inspections may occasionally cause delays outside our control.
5) Missing or Delayed Packages
• If your order shows as “Delivered” but you have not received it, please:
• Check with neighbors, reception, or your building management.
• Confirm the shipping address provided during checkout.
• If your tracking hasn’t updated for more than 7 business days, please contact us and we will liaise with the courier.
6) Contact
For help tracking your order, please contact us:

faq.question: REPEATED RETURNS
blocks: We offer a flexible returns policy to facilitate your online shopping experience. We also monitor the number of returns made by our customers. Repeated returns in breach of our General Sales Conditions will be flagged and may, at our discretion, lead to the closure of your account or refusal of future orders.

faq.question: HAS MY ORDER BEEN SENT?
blocks: If you have created a FLORENCESS customer account, you can view your order status at any time. Simply log in to your account and click on “My Orders.” You may then select your desired order, view the details of your purchase and the status of your shipment.

faq.question: HOW LONG DOES DELIVERY TAKE?
blocks: With limited production and inventory not as large as expected, normally, we can ship the goods the next day. Should any items be unavailable, the preparation time may be modified. Availability delays will be communicated.
Delivery time is estimated from the time your order is shipped, depending on your shipping destination and the specificity of your order.

The exact delivery date including the preparation of your order and shipping will be determined at checkout. Orders shipping to remote areas of Alaska and Hawaii may experience longer shipping lead time, which will be reflected correctly at checkout according to the zipcode of delivery.
Orders including Fine Jewelry and Watches are automatically upgraded to Express delivery.

Deliveries will be made Monday through Friday (including holidays) and on Saturday in eligible locations. A signature will be required upon delivery. FLORENCESS cannot be held responsible for any unanticipated delivery delays such as inclement weather on the delivery route. Our carrier will attempt to deliver your order up to three times before returning it to our distribution center.

faq.question: WHAT SALES TAX WILL I BE CHARGED?
blocks: Your sales tax will automatically be calculated and added to your order total upon entering your shipping address and selecting your shipping method.

faq.question: HOW CAN I ACCESS MY ORDER HISTORY?
blocks: If you have created a FLORENCESS customer account, you can view your order history. Simply log in to your account and click on “My Orders.” You may then select your desired order to view the details of your purchase, the status of your shipment, and information on your returns.

faq.question: ARE THERE ANY DELIVERY RESTRICTIONS?
blocks: Items can only be delivered to the shipping address indicated at the time of placing the order. Addresses cannot be modified once the order has been placed or once the order is in transit. A signature is required upon delivery and cannot be waived. Orders cannot be delivered to hotels, freight forwarders, military bases, post office boxes. Our carrier will attempt to deliver your order up to three times before returning it to our distribution center.

faq.question: HOW CAN I FIND A PRODUCT ON FLORENCESS.COM?
blocks: The products on the website are organized by categories and by product line.
Please use the search engine, indicated by a magnifying glass, and enter the key words. All the products with a relevant match to your search will be presented.

faq.question: WHAT IS FLORENECESS' POLICY ON CONFIDENTIALITY?
blocks: The processing, confidentiality, and security of your personal data is important to us. We are committed to offering you personalized services while respecting your privacy and choices in accordance with the applicable personal data regulations, in particular, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) for customers residing in the EU, and those regulations applicable to you as residents of your home State for customers residing in the US.

In order to provide you with the same personalized service worldwide, we take all necessary safeguards, notably contractual, technical, and organizational measures to guarantee the privacy and security of your data and to protect such data from any misrepresentation, damage, destruction, or access by unauthorized third parties.

It is important that you can control your personal data. In accordance with GDPR, you have the right to access and make corrections to your personal data, in addition to the right to request its removal, to oppose the use of your data providing you have a legitimate reason, and to obtain limitation and portability as far as this is applicable. You are also able to request to no longer receive personalized communications about our products and services.

faq.question: IS AN ONLINE PURCHASE ON FLORENCESS.COM SECURE?
blocks: All transactions done on the FLORENCESS.com website are extremely secure. An SSL encryption system is in place to protect personal data and payment information. In addition, FLORENCESS makes a commitment to you not to save any credit card information.

faq.question: WHAT ARE THE BENEFITS OF CREATING A FLORENCESS ACCOUNT?
blocks: Creating a FLORENCESS account will enable you to
- Save and manage your personal information
- Create and share your personal shopping cart and bookmarks
- Have a list of your online and store purchases
- Track your online orders
- Exchange or return products
- Receive our latest product and event updates

faq.question: HOW CAN I SUBSCRIBE/UNSUBSCRIBE TO THE FLORENCESS NEWSLETTER?
blocks: To subscribe to our newsletter, please visit the "Newsletter" section and fill in the registration form.
If you wish to unsubscribe from our newsletter, click on the link at the bottom of each FLORENCESS newsletter.
By subscribing to the FashionMustBuy Newsletter, you will be one of the first to hear about new products, events and news from the House of FLORENCESS.

faq.question: I PLACED AN ORDER BUT I HAVE NOT RECEIVED MY PACKAGE. WHAT CAN I DO?
blocks: If you have created a FLORENCESS customer account, you can view your order status at any time. Simply log in to your account and click on “My Orders.” You may then select your desired order, view the details of your purchase and the status of your shipment.
If you have placed an order as a guest, you may view your order status by using your order number and email on the Manage Your Order portion of our Delivery and Returns page.

faq.question: CAN I RETURN A PRODUCT THAT WAS ORDERED ONLINE FOR EXCHANGE OR REFUND?
blocks: You can return any order to us within 7 days of receiving it. After the express delivery is signed for, please contact our Customer Service with a logistics screenshot for a return or exchange.

Product(s) must be returned in the original packaging, accompanied by any accessories and documents provided (notices, guarantees, return tags, certificates of authenticity). Any damaged, used, incomplete or soiled product(s) cannot be returned or exchanged. All shoes must be tried on a soft, clean and dry carpeted area in order to avoid any damage to the soles. Failure to do so may result in non-acceptance of your return or exchange.

Similarly, personalized items produced according to and/or at the request of the customer, or products that have been altered, as well as sealed items (swimwear, etc.) that have been unsealed after delivery and cannot be returned for reasons of hygiene or health protection cannot be exchanged.
An item can only be exchanged once, the item received in exchange can therefore only be returned for a refund under the usual conditions.

If the product meets our return conditions, you will be reimbursed to your original payment method, or your exchange order will be processed. Any item that is returned damaged, used, incomplete, or soiled will not be refunded and will be sent back to you. Please allow up to 7 business days for all returns and exchanges to be processed.
